description: Réseaux gaz GrDF en service sur le territoire de la Métropole de Lyon is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Métropole de Lyon. Data on gas networks in operation, available on the GrDF open data website ( The dataset is based on the following open dataset, located in the Metropolis of Lyon: - In-service GRDF network mapping = The 'insee' and 'commune' attributes have been recalculated from the commune rights-of-way available on data.grandlyon.com, in order to allow data ... Coverage: Métropole de Lyon. The portal shows the English title as "GrDF gas networks in operation on the territory of the Metropolis of Lyon" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Métropole de Lyon. The listing shows 3 download or service links in GEOJSON, SHP, CSV. The listing shows 2026-06-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
